tests.scope: Ten overlapping local/profile/HMMER/pilot/readback modules, including59 dedicated selector/decision/stage cases. Do not sum overlapping receipts as independent coverage.

selection: Original significant external profile hits, duplicate maxima, complete source ownership and original thresholds; ambiguous queries only, with positive initial sequence support in either direction. Retain unanchored blockers and an original own profile when available. Maximum4 external plus own,128 queries and128 distinct profiles. Rank nearest original best-external/self boundary then canonical gene name; never truncate competitors to fit budgets. Preserve all exclusion reasons and genes without external hits, source memberships, priority and a canonical content digest.
anchor_control: Stream original hit arrays twice and keep per-member directional records only for selected queries. Preserve the original positive outgoing record over a reverse duplicate even if reverse is stronger, then maximum score and original member-order ties. Graph weights remain original initial-hit weights, never native raw-profile or HMMER bit scores.
decisions: Use a unique highest complete-data score across all competitors before self/E-value/anchor gates. Reject ties, own winner, failed strict sequence E<1e-4, score below complete member minimum, or unanchored winner without weaker fallback. Missing competitor/query/member measurements preserve the original decision; malformed or failed backends raise and preserve failure evidence.
stage: Off delegates directly to historical edge construction without nomination/tools/artifacts. Active experimental calls require a fresh evidence directory and CPU-only1..16 budget. Native reselect measures the same targets through original CPU scoring at band64, checks every original self minimum exactly and uses complete-proteome residue significance. HMMER arms use the already-tested standard3.4 backend with bounded profile concurrency. Measurement-only returns exact original undirected edge arrays; active reselect replaces directed query anchors before deduplication so unselected reciprocal proposals survive. Fresh receipts retain nomination, original selected anchors, measurement files, counterfactual/applied changes and terminal failures.
actual_fixtures: Actual native profiles/CPU self-rescoring and genuine installed HMMER3.4 builds/searches feed complete decisions and graph-edge construction for all three active arms. Tests verify complete own/four-external competition, profile/query budgets, duplicate/input-order/global/family-index invariance, unanchored blockers, exact/printed ties, native significance/full-residue calibration, byte-identical measurement control, genuine incomplete-measurement preservation and failed-tool distinction. Synthetic fixtures are not biological accuracy or generalization evidence.
remaining: Integrate the explicit experimental stage into authenticated profile graph replay without altering default production behavior or the frozen weighting scientific source.
Test unchanged full graph/candidate/native controls and nonempty final native integration; freeze the four-arm pilot source/manifest before complete-proteome applicability and OrthoBench evaluation.
Independently admit activation, ownership, products and scores; apply original fixed point gates to both active reselect arms, preserving all negative/inactive/failure results.
Execute unchanged full-vector follow-up for advancing arms only, assess HMMER-specific versus decision-only effects, and add a production opt-in interface only if warranted.
original_cpu_libraries: All three original hashes unchanged; no recompilation. Unrelated tests/samples status and binary-diff fingerprints unchanged.
